query: Semiconductor fabrication packaging testing country of origin CBP rulings

statements.text: the CBP officials at the port of importation are satisfied that the semiconductor devices will reach their ultimate purchaser in these marked containers, then the individual semiconductor devices can be excepted from having to be marked to indicate their country of origin.

In T.D. 75-187, dated July 22,1975, CBP allowed a disjunctive listing of multiple countries of origin when the articles (semiconductor devices, including transistors, diodes, and integrated circuits) were commingled for a bona fide reason, and subsequently repackaged for sale to an ultimate purchaser.
